row_owner_frontend.limits: This value belongs to row-owner placement/removal of replication and wide gather, not fusion itself; no extra mHC credit added and no P90 recomputation.

OA_incremental_gate.mechanism: A different kernel may fuse OA/send layout or share a larger SMLA/inverse-RoPE/OA producer. The current API cannot emit that packet directly.
OA_incremental_gate.formula: Per-window old pack+AllToAll minus1%period minus paired native OA increment. This mixes cohorts only as a conditional screening model;it is not a measured service saving or hard runtime bound.
OA_incremental_gate.gate: A new implementation or source-supported schedule must provide a material net case;do not repeat stock permutations or benchmark hot single weights.

SMLA_output.limits: Direct-KV and OA phases have no aligned joint implementation model yet. Do not sum their gains; OA send fusion must meet the whole-cut incremental gate.
